verses.display_text: Jesus says to him, “Have I been with you for so long a time, and you have not known Me, Philip? The one who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

verses.text: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words that I say to you I do not speak from Myself; but the Father, who remains in Me, does His works.
verses.display_text: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words that I say to you I do not speak from Myself; but the Father, who remains in Me, does His works.

verses.text: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me. But if not, believe because of the works themselves.
verses.display_text: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me. But if not, believe because of the works themselves.

verses.text: Amen, amen, I say to you: the one who believes in Me will also do the works that I do, and will do greater works than these, because I am going to the Father.
verses.display_text: Amen, amen, I say to you: the one who believes in Me will also do the works that I do, and will do greater works than these, because I am going to the Father.

verses.text: And whatever you ask in My name, this I will do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.display_text: And whatever you ask in My name, this I will do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

verses.text: If you ask Me anything in My name, I will do it.
verses.display_text: If you ask Me anything in My name, I will do it.

verses.text: “If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
verses.display_text: “If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

verses.text: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate, so that He may be with you forever:
verses.display_text: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate, so that He may be with you forever:

verses.text: the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither beholds Him nor knows Him. You know Him, because He remains with you and will be in you.
verses.display_text: the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither beholds Him nor knows Him. You know Him, because He remains with you and will be in you.

verses.text: I will not leave you orphans; I am coming to you.
verses.display_text: I will not leave you orphans; I am coming to you.

verses.text: Yet a little while, and the world no longer beholds Me, but you behold Me. Because I live, you also will live.
verses.display_text: Yet a little while, and the world no longer beholds Me, but you behold Me. Because I live, you also will live.

verses.text: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you in Me, and I in you.
verses.display_text: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you in Me, and I in you.

verses.text: The one who has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. And the one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”
verses.display_text: The one who has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. And the one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”

verses.text: Judas—not the Iscariot—says to Him, “Lord, what then has happened that Thou art going to reveal Thyself to us and not to the world?”
verses.display_text: Judas—not the Iscariot—says to Him, “Lord, what then has happened that Thou art going to reveal Thyself to us and not to the world?”

verses.text: Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word, and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our dwelling with him.
verses.display_text: Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word, and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our dwelling with him.

verses.text: The one who does not love Me does not keep My words. And the word that you hear is not Mine, but the Father’s who sent Me.
verses.display_text: The one who does not love Me does not keep My words. And the word that you hear is not Mine, but the Father’s who sent Me.

verses.text: “These things I have spoken to you while remaining with you.
verses.display_text: “These things I have spoken to you while remaining with you.

verses.text: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things and remind you of all that I said to you.
verses.display_text: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things and remind you of all that I said to you.

verses.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your heart be troubled or afraid.
verses.display_text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your heart be troubled or afraid.

verses.text: You heard that I said to you, ‘I am going away, and I am coming to you.’ If you loved Me, you would have rejoiced that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
verses.display_text: You heard that I said to you, ‘I am going away, and I am coming to you.’ If you loved Me, you would have rejoiced that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

verses.text: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it happens you may believe.
verses.display_text: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it happens you may believe.

verses.text: I will no longer speak much with you, for the ruler of the world is coming, and he has nothing in Me.
verses.display_text: I will no longer speak much with you, for the ruler of the world is coming, and he has nothing in Me.

verses.text: But so that the world may know that I love the Father, I do just as the Father commanded Me. Rise, let us go from here.”
verses.display_text: But so that the world may know that I love the Father, I do just as the Father commanded Me. Rise, let us go from here.”

verses.text: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the vinegrower.
verses.display_text: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the vinegrower.

verses.text: Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit He takes away; and every one that bears fruit He prunes, so that it may bear more fruit.
verses.display_text: Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit He takes away; and every one that bears fruit He prunes, so that it may bear more fruit.

verses.text: You are already clean because of the word that I have spoken to you.
verses.display_text: You are already clean because of the word that I have spoken to you.

verses.text: Remain in Me, and I in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit from itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you unless you remain in Me.
verses.display_text: Remain in Me, and I in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit from itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you unless you remain in Me.

verses.text: I am the vine; you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit, because apart from Me you can do nothing.
verses.display_text: I am the vine; you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit, because apart from Me you can do nothing.

verses.text: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is thrown outside like the branch and withers; and they gather them and throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.display_text: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is thrown outside like the branch and withers; and they gather them and throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

verses.text: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
verses.display_text: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.

verses.text: In this My Father has been glorified: that you bear much fruit and become My disciples.
verses.display_text: In this My Father has been glorified: that you bear much fruit and become My disciples.

verses.text: Just as the Father loved Me, I also loved you. Remain in My love.
verses.display_text: Just as the Father loved Me, I also loved you. Remain in My love.

verses.text: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
verses.display_text: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.

verses.text: These things I have spoken to you so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be made full.
verses.display_text: These things I have spoken to you so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be made full.

verses.text: “This is My commandment: that you love one another just as I loved you.
verses.display_text: “This is My commandment: that you love one another just as I loved you.

verses.text: No one has greater love than this: that someone should lay down his life for his friends.
verses.display_text: No one has greater love than this: that someone should lay down his life for his friends.

verses.text: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
verses.display_text: You are My friends if you do what I command you.

verses.text: I no longer call you slaves, because the slave does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything that I heard from My Father.
verses.display_text: I no longer call you slaves, because the slave does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything that I heard from My Father.

verses.text: You did not choose Me, but I chose you, and appointed you so that you should go and bear fruit and your fruit should remain, so that whatever you ask the Father in My name He may give you.
verses.display_text: You did not choose Me, but I chose you, and appointed you so that you should go and bear fruit and your fruit should remain, so that whatever you ask the Father in My name He may give you.

verses.text: These things I command you, so that you love one another.
verses.display_text: These things I command you, so that you love one another.

verses.text: “If the world hates you, know that it has hated Me before you.
verses.display_text: “If the world hates you, know that it has hated Me before you.

verses.text: If you were from the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not from the world, but I chose you out of the world, for this reason the world hates you.
verses.display_text: If you were from the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not from the world, but I chose you out of the world, for this reason the world hates you.

verses.text: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A slave is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will also persecute you; if they kept My word, they will also keep yours.
verses.display_text: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A slave is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will also persecute you; if they kept My word, they will also keep yours.

verses.text: But they will do all these things to you because of My name, because they do not know the One who sent Me.
verses.display_text: But they will do all these things to you because of My name, because they do not know the One who sent Me.

verses.text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would have no sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.display_text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would have no sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

verses.text: The one who hates Me hates My Father also.
verses.display_text: The one who hates Me hates My Father also.

verses.text: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would have no sin; but now they have both seen and hated both Me and My Father.
verses.display_text: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would have no sin; but now they have both seen and hated both Me and My Father.

verses.text: But this is so that the word written in their law might be fulfilled: ‘They hated Me without cause.’
verses.display_text: But this is so that the word written in their law might be fulfilled: ‘They hated Me without cause.’

verses.text: “When the Advocate comes, whom I will send you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father, He will bear witness about Me.
verses.display_text: “When the Advocate comes, whom I will send you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father, He will bear witness about Me.

verses.text: And you also bear witness, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
verses.display_text: And you also bear witness, because you have been with Me from the beginning.

verses.text: “These things I have spoken to you so that you may not stumble.
verses.display_text: “These things I have spoken to you so that you may not stumble.

verses.text: They will put you out of the synagogues; indeed, an hour is coming when everyone who kills you will think he is offering worship to God.
verses.display_text: They will put you out of the synagogues; indeed, an hour is coming when everyone who kills you will think he is offering worship to God.

verses.text: And they will do these things because they have known neither the Father nor Me.
verses.display_text: And they will do these things because they have known neither the Father nor Me.

verses.text: But these things I have spoken to you so that, when their hour comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.display_text: But these things I have spoken to you so that, when their hour comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

verses.text: But now I am going to the One who sent Me, and none of you asks Me, ‘Where art Thou going?’
verses.display_text: But now I am going to the One who sent Me, and none of you asks Me, ‘Where art Thou going?’

verses.text: But because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.
verses.display_text: But because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.

verses.text: Yet I tell you the truth: it is better for you that I go away. For if I do not go away, the Advocate certainly will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.
verses.display_text: Yet I tell you the truth: it is better for you that I go away. For if I do not go away, the Advocate certainly will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.

verses.text: And when He comes, He will convict the world concerning sin and concerning righteousness and concerning judgment:
verses.display_text: And when He comes, He will convict the world concerning sin and concerning righteousness and concerning judgment:

verses.text: concerning sin, because they do not believe in Me;
verses.display_text: concerning sin, because they do not believe in Me;

verses.text: concerning righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you no longer behold Me;
verses.display_text: concerning righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you no longer behold Me;

verses.text: and concerning judgment, because the ruler of this world has been judged.
verses.display_text: and concerning judgment, because the ruler of this world has been judged.

verses.text: “I still have many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now.
verses.display_text: “I still have many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now.

verses.text: But when He comes, the Spirit of truth, He will guide you in all the truth; for He will not speak from Himself, but will speak whatever He hears, and will announce to you the things to come.
verses.display_text: But when He comes, the Spirit of truth, He will guide you in all the truth; for He will not speak from Himself, but will speak whatever He hears, and will announce to you the things to come.

verses.text: He will glorify Me, because He will receive from what is Mine and announce it to you.
verses.display_text: He will glorify Me, because He will receive from what is Mine and announce it to you.

verses.text: Everything that the Father has is Mine. For this reason I said that He receives from what is Mine and will announce it to you.
verses.display_text: Everything that the Father has is Mine. For this reason I said that He receives from what is Mine and will announce it to you.

verses.text: “A little while, and you no longer behold Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me.”
verses.display_text: “A little while, and you no longer behold Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me.”

verses.text: Then some of His disciples said to one another, “What is this that He says to us: ‘A little while, and you do not behold Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me,’ and, ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”
verses.display_text: Then some of His disciples said to one another, “What is this that He says to us: ‘A little while, and you do not behold Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me,’ and, ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”

verses.text: So they were saying, “What is this ‘little while’ that He speaks of? We do not know what He is saying.”
verses.display_text: So they were saying, “What is this ‘little while’ that He speaks of? We do not know what He is saying.”

verses.text: Jesus knew that they wanted to ask Him, and said to them, “Are you seeking an answer among yourselves about this, because I said, ‘A little while, and you do not behold Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me’?
verses.display_text: Jesus knew that they wanted to ask Him, and said to them, “Are you seeking an answer among yourselves about this, because I said, ‘A little while, and you do not behold Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me’?

verses.text: Amen, amen, I say to you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will become joy.
verses.display_text: Amen, amen, I say to you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will become joy.

verses.text: When a woman is giving birth, she has sorrow because her hour has come; but when she has borne the child, she no longer remembers the anguish because of the joy that a human being has been born into the world.
verses.display_text: When a woman is giving birth, she has sorrow because her hour has come; but when she has borne the child, she no longer remembers the anguish because of the joy that a human being has been born into the world.

verses.text: So you too now have sorrow; but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one takes your joy away from you.
verses.display_text: So you too now have sorrow; but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one takes your joy away from you.

verses.text: And on that day you will ask Me nothing. Amen, amen, I say to you: if you ask the Father anything, He will give it to you in My name.
verses.display_text: And on that day you will ask Me nothing. Amen, amen, I say to you: if you ask the Father anything, He will give it to you in My name.

verses.text: Until now you have asked nothing in My name. Ask, and you will receive, so that your joy may be made full.
verses.display_text: Until now you have asked nothing in My name. Ask, and you will receive, so that your joy may be made full.

verses.text: “These things I have spoken to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
verses.display_text: “These things I have spoken to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

verses.text: On that day you will ask in My name; and I do not say to you that I will ask the Father concerning you,
verses.display_text: On that day you will ask in My name; and I do not say to you that I will ask the Father concerning you,

verses.text: for the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came forth from God.
verses.display_text: for the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came forth from God.

verses.text: I came forth from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I am leaving the world and going to the Father.”
verses.display_text: I came forth from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I am leaving the world and going to the Father.”

verses.text: His disciples say, “See, now Thou speakest plainly and usest no figure of speech.
verses.display_text: His disciples say, “See, now Thou speakest plainly and usest no figure of speech.

verses.text: Now we know that Thou knowest all things, and hast no need for anyone to question Thee. By this we believe that Thou didst come forth from God.”
verses.display_text: Now we know that Thou knowest all things, and hast no need for anyone to question Thee. By this we believe that Thou didst come forth from God.”

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
verses.display_text: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

verses.text: Behold, an hour is coming, and has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own, and will leave Me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
verses.display_text: Behold, an hour is coming, and has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own, and will leave Me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.

verses.text: These things I have spoken to you so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you have affliction; but take courage: I have overcome the world.”
verses.display_text: These things I have spoken to you so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you have affliction; but take courage: I have overcome the world.”

verses.text: Jesus spoke these things, and, lifting His eyes to heaven, said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Thy Son, so that the Son may glorify Thee,
verses.display_text: Jesus spoke these things, and, lifting His eyes to heaven, said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Thy Son, so that the Son may glorify Thee,

verses.text: just as Thou gavest Him authority over all flesh, so that He may give eternal life to them—to all that Thou hast given Him.
verses.display_text: just as Thou gavest Him authority over all flesh, so that He may give eternal life to them—to all that Thou hast given Him.

verses.text: And this is eternal life: that they know Thee, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom Thou didst send.
verses.display_text: And this is eternal life: that they know Thee, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom Thou didst send.

verses.text: I glorified Thee on the earth, having completed the work that Thou hast given Me to do.
verses.display_text: I glorified Thee on the earth, having completed the work that Thou hast given Me to do.

verses.text: And now, Father, glorify Me with Thyself, with the glory that I had with Thee before the world existed.
verses.display_text: And now, Father, glorify Me with Thyself, with the glory that I had with Thee before the world existed.

verses.text: “I revealed Thy name to the people whom Thou gavest Me out of the world. They were Thine, and Thou gavest them to Me, and they have kept Thy word.
verses.display_text: “I revealed Thy name to the people whom Thou gavest Me out of the world. They were Thine, and Thou gavest them to Me, and they have kept Thy word.

verses.text: Now they have known that everything Thou hast given Me is from Thee,
verses.display_text: Now they have known that everything Thou hast given Me is from Thee,

verses.text: because the words that Thou gavest Me I have given them; and they received them and truly knew that I came forth from Thee, and believed that Thou didst send Me.
verses.display_text: because the words that Thou gavest Me I have given them; and they received them and truly knew that I came forth from Thee, and believed that Thou didst send Me.

verses.text: I ask concerning them. I do not ask concerning the world, but concerning those whom Thou hast given Me, because they are Thine;
verses.display_text: I ask concerning them. I do not ask concerning the world, but concerning those whom Thou hast given Me, because they are Thine;

verses.text: and all that is Mine is Thine, and what is Thine is Mine, and I have been glorified in them.
verses.display_text: and all that is Mine is Thine, and what is Thine is Mine, and I have been glorified in them.

verses.display_text: When I was with them, I kept them in Thy name, which Thou hast given Me, and guarded them; and not one of them perished except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

verses.text: But now I am coming to Thee, and I speak these things in the world so that they may have My joy made full within themselves.
